li.label: an old kindness repaid
li.description: An envoy came up the road to repay something we did for their people long ago. I'd nearly forgotten we did it.

li.label: help from old friends
li.description: Things got hard here, and people we once helped sent help up the road. They wouldn't take a coin for it.

li.label: the old feud is over
li.description: We've made peace with people we fought for years. I'll need a while to stop watching the treeline.

li.label: judged a quarrel fairly
li.description: Two peoples brought me their quarrel, and both went home thinking the answer was fair.

li.label: a guest at the neighbors' feast
li.description: We walked for days to sit at their tables, and they fed us until we couldn't move. One of their songs is still in my head.

li.label: learned from a master
li.description: Days at a real master's side, watching their hands. I'll never do the work the old way again.

li.label: an honored guest left pleased
li.description: A guest of rank stayed with us and found nothing to complain about but the road here.

li.label: saw the refugees through
li.description: People with nowhere else to go ate at our table and slept under our roof until they could go on. One of them held my hands at the gate and wouldn't let go.
